questions.question: At Buffalo Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019/20 season?
Who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' in the 25/26 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Aphilile Adonisi holds it, with a total of 24.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Sixes' in the 23/24 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 31.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Knights?
Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Jana Nell or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Jana Nell: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.
